title: Platform Workflow and API Process (Retrospective Reference)
description: Daily attempt limits, staged unlock thresholds, and exercise/debug window structure
detail:
Structure from a past online assessment exercise (a future AI-KOH event may differ; follow official documentation):
1. The agent uses the platform API to obtain target information (target host IP/port, proof-artifact submission endpoint, vulnerability hints), start/stop target hosts, submit proof artifacts, and query hints
2. Each team starts with 3 challenge attempts per day (refreshed the next day); unlocking a new area adds +1 that day (cap 3)
3. Staged unlock: the current area must reach a proof-artifact threshold before entering the next area (previous thresholds were 14/6/9)
4. Exercise windows (e.g., 10:00-13:00, 15:00-18:00): the agent runs autonomously and SSH may disconnect; debug windows allow logging in to adjust code but not attacking target hosts
5. Querying hints incurs a score penalty (-10%); answer points are locked in immediately
Preparation actions: align arena.json endpoints with documentation before the event; use a test target during the debug window to validate the full chain; prepare launch orchestration (run automatically when the exercise starts).
